items.text: To receive God’s most valuable blessings, His covenant blessings, it’s not necessary to supplant someone else. His blessings aren’t purchased or seized or won. He gives them freely to all who live up to the name of Israel—who let God prevail in their lives.

Jacob declared, 'I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.' This profound declaration teaches us the power of persistent faith and the willingness to wrestle with our challenges until we receive God’s blessings, transforming our very identity.

Covenant marriage is essential to God’s eternal plan. The qualities found in individuals like Rebekah, who contributed to a strong marriage and family, are vital. We must ponder why marriage is so important to God and strive to build eternal relationships.

We can value eternal things over temporal things by understanding the difference between fleeting worldly desires and everlasting blessings. By focusing on the Savior and the eternal promises of His gospel, we can choose wisdom over immediate gratification.

The covenants of the Lord’s house bring God’s power into our lives. Jacob’s dream at Bethel revealed the sacredness of God’s house and His promises. The temple reminds us of these covenants and helps us feel nearer to God.

Jacob’s experience at Bethel was life-changing, leading him to declare, 'Surely the Lord is in this place.' This sacred encounter underscores how God is present in His holy temples, where we can learn about Him and His covenants.

The hymn 'Nearer, My God, to Thee' is based on Jacob’s experience, reminding us that keeping temple covenants helps us feel nearer to God. The temple is a place where we can receive divine power and feel His presence.

The Lord remembers us in our trials. Just as God looked upon Rachel and Leah’s afflictions and remembered them, He sees and remembers us. His mercy is a constant source of comfort and hope during our challenging times.

As Jacob returned to Canaan, he was greatly afraid and distressed about his brother Esau. This fear highlights the potential for reconciliation and healing within families, even after periods of discord and separation.

Be creative in your learning from the scriptures. Drawing pictures, listening to sacred music, or exploring various approaches can deepen your understanding and bring spiritual insights. Don't limit yourself to just reading; explore diverse methods.
